source: arXiv:2509.24254 — Wu, Akin, Martineau, Grégoire, Veneris (2025). Accepted ACM ICAIF 2025.
title: H293 — Press Release Structure Signal for PEAD (FinBERT + Structural Topic Score)
rationale: Wu et al. (2025) show that structural features of earnings press releases (soft information) predict announcement-day returns and are AS informative as EPS surprise (hard information) across 138K+ releases 2005-2023. FinBERT is the highest-performing model. The key innovation is extracting structural elements (guidance sections, metric tables, management tone by section) rather than treating the document as a flat text blob. This directly upgrades H174 (OOS WR 81.8%, n=22) which uses a single FinBERT score on the full 8-K document. Adding a structural decomposition (intro tone, key metrics section, forward guidance section scored separately) could sharpen discrimination. Paper finding: 'stock prices fully reflect content at market open' — the signal must be traded pre-open (OPG order), which matches H174's existing execution model. Approach: split 8-K text into named sections using regex (RESULTS/GUIDANCE/COMMENTARY patterns), score each with FinBERT, weight guidance section 2× (most forward-looking). Gate improvement target: OOS WR > 81.8% with n >= 15.
content:
Script scaffold for H293: Press Release Structure PEAD Enhancement.

Hypothesis:
  H174 uses full 8-K FinBERT score (single number). Wu et al. (2025) show
  structural decomposition improves discrimination. Test: split press release
  into sections (HIGHLIGHTS, RESULTS, GUIDANCE, COMMENTARY) via regex;
  score each section with FinBERT; compute weighted composite:
    score_composite = 0.3*score_highlights + 0.2*score_results + 0.5*score_guidance
  Apply same H174 dual gate: composite_score >= 0.18 AND EPS_surprise >= 0.02.
  IS: 2018-2022, OOS: 2023-2025.
  Gate: OOS WR > 81.8% (H174 baseline), n >= 15.

Section extraction regex patterns:
  highlights_pattern = r'(?i)(highlight|key result|summary)(.*?)(?=\n\n[A-Z]|guidance|outlook|$)'
  results_pattern = r'(?i)(financial result|revenue|earnings|eps)(.*?)(?=\n\n[A-Z]|guidance|$)'
  guidance_pattern = r'(?i)(guidance|outlook|forecast|expect)(.*?)(?=\n\n[A-Z]|$)'

Note: Uses same H174 EDGAR 8-K download pipeline and FinBERT model (ProsusAI/finbert).
Compatible with existing pead_overnight.py production flow.

This is a scaffold — implementation should be derived from run_h163.py/run_h174.py
with the section-splitting logic added above the FinBERT scoring step.
